description:
Look a Proto-Scythian lemma up on Wiktionary and return its senses plus
its full descendants payload — the reconstructed etymology and the reflex
tree down to Ossetian and Khotanese, attested scholarship, not invention.
Plain ASCII spellings are folded to the reconstruction's diacritics and
the result notes the resolution. With search_language='eng' the query is
an English word instead: the result lists the lemmas whose glosses match
it (the translations block) plus their expanded entries. Returns Markdown
plus the same result as structuredContent matching the declared
outputSchema.

Results are cached server-side; first-time queries reach the live
upstream politely and calls are rate limited — on a rate-limit error,
wait a few seconds and retry. Content is from en.wiktionary.org
(CC BY-SA 4.0 — attribute and share alike if republished).

SearchLanguage.description:
The query language. ``xsc`` (ISO 639-3 Scythian; Wiktionary's entry code is
``xsc-pro``) looks a Proto-Scythian lemma up directly — ASCII spellings are
folded (``tigri`` finds ``*tiɣri``) via the reverse index. ``eng`` searches in
reverse: the English query is matched against the indexed glosses of all
lemmas, and each match is then looked up normally.
SearchLanguage.title: SearchLanguage

include_forms.description: When true (default), each match's full descendants payload — etymology, glosses and the reflex tree down to Ossetian and Khotanese — is returned INLINE in ONE call, no follow-up scythian_get_descendants. Set false for a cheap screen of which entries exist. Bounded by a per-search cap — use max_forms to adjust per call. For eng queries this governs the expanded entries; the matched-lemmas list itself is always returned.
include_forms.title: Include Forms

max_forms.description: Optional override for how many descendants payloads to expand this call (0–12). On an uncached query each payload is one politely paced upstream fetch, so high values on cold queries are slow. Omit for the server default.
max_forms.title: Max Forms

query.description: The word to look up, in the language search_language names. Scythian (default): a SINGLE Proto-Scythian lemma — plain ASCII works ('tigri' finds *tiɣri: macrons and carons are folded, and ɣ→g, δ→d, β→b, ə→e, θ→t or th), with or without the reconstruction asterisk. English (search_language='eng'): the English word whose Proto-Scythian equivalents you want — matched against every entry's glosses.
query.title: Query

search_language.description: Language the query word is in: 'xsc' (default) looks the Proto-Scythian lemma up directly; 'eng' finds the lemmas whose English glosses match the query (the local gloss index — reconstructed languages have no translation tables) and returns their full entries. Glosses are in English either way.

name: scythian_search

DescendantNode.description:
One node of a descendants tree: a reflex of the Proto-Scythian lemma in a
descendant (or borrowing) language, with its own descendants nested below.
``form`` keeps the asterisk on reconstructed reflexes (``*ćirɣ``) and may be
empty for a branch header (``Ossetian`` above its dialect lines) or a term
Wiktionary records only in transliteration ("script needed").

form.description: The reflex as printed (asterisk kept on reconstructions); may be empty for a branch header or a transliteration-only term.
form.title: Form

qualifier.description: How the word travelled or which variety carries it, e.g. 'borrowed', 'Digor'; empty for plain inheritance.
qualifier.title: Qualifier

transliteration.description: Romanization as printed beside the form, e.g. 'cirǧ'.
transliteration.title: Transliteration

DescendantNode.title: DescendantNode

DescendantsHandle.description:
A structured anchor for fetching one entry's descendants: feed ``entry_id``
(the bare lemma) + ``word_class`` (the POS section) to
``scythian_get_descendants`` — or ask ``search`` to include the tree inline
(``forms``).

entry_id.description: The bare lemma — the page-title tail, no asterisk.
entry_id.title: Entry Id

forms.description: The full descendants payload, populated when a search is asked to include it; None when not requested or beyond the cap. (Proto-Scythian has no inflection tables — this 'forms' slot carries descendants.)
forms.title: Forms

DescendantsHandle.title: DescendantsHandle

DescendantsNotFound.description:
No Proto-Scythian entry for this page/POS (no such page, no Proto-Scythian
section, or nothing parseable in it). ``found`` is False and there is no body.

source.default: Wiktionary, the free dictionary (en.wiktionary.org), Proto-Scythian reconstruction entries. Wikimedia Foundation. (CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) Adapted: reformatted and condensed from the original.
source.title: Source

DescendantsNotFound.title: DescendantsNotFound

Entry.description:
One Proto-Scythian entry on the page: the reconstructed headword (asterisk
included) with one part-of-speech section's senses.
Entry.title: Entry

ScythianDescendants.description:
One entry's descendants payload: the headword, its English glosses and the
reflex tree. ``tree`` MAY be empty — the entry exists but Wiktionary records no
reflexes — while ``glosses`` still feed the English-query reverse index.
``category`` discriminates this from the not-found shape — switch on it before
reading the body.

entry_id.description: The bare lemma (page-title tail, no asterisk).
entry_id.title: Entry Id

etymology.description: The entry's etymology line, plain text; may be empty.
etymology.title: Etymology

glosses.description: The entry's English glosses — also what an eng search matches.
glosses.title: Glosses

headword.description: The headword as printed, asterisk included: '*tiɣri'.
headword.title: Headword

source.default: Wiktionary, the free dictionary (en.wiktionary.org), Proto-Scythian reconstruction entries. Wikimedia Foundation. Text available under CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and share-alike required when republishing. (CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) Adapted: reformatted and condensed from the original.
source.title: Source

tree.description: The descendants tree in page order; empty when the entry records no reflexes.
tree.title: Tree

ScythianDescendants.title: ScythianDescendants

The query language. ``xsc`` (ISO 639-3 Scythian; Wiktionary's entry code is
``xsc-pro``) looks a Proto-Scythian lemma up directly — ASCII spellings are
folded (``tigri`` finds ``*tiɣri``) via the reverse index. ``eng`` searches in

SearchLanguage.title: SearchLanguage

Sense.description: One sense of an entry: the (HTML-stripped) Wiktionary definition line.
Sense.title: Sense

TranslationSense.description:
One English query sense and the Proto-Scythian lemmas whose glosses match
it. Matching is by the local gloss index (built from every entry's glosses) —
Wiktionary's translation tables exclude reconstructed languages, so there is no
per-sense table to mine; the single sense carries the query itself.

sense.description: The matched English gloss key — the query.
sense.title: Sense

TranslationSense.title: TranslationSense

TranslationTerm.description:
One Proto-Scythian lemma the gloss index offers for an English query.
``word`` is the bare lemma (what an ``eng`` search re-searches and what
``scythian_get_descendants`` needs).
TranslationTerm.title: TranslationTerm

outputSchema.description: The result of a dictionary search.

forms_truncated.description: How many handles did NOT get an inline descendants payload because the per-search cap was reached.
forms_truncated.title: Forms Truncated

found.description: False when nothing matched. For an eng query, True means the gloss index named Proto-Scythian lemmas — entries may still be empty when none of them could be expanded (see translations).
found.title: Found

resolved_from.description: The original query when resolved via the index; else empty. xsc queries only — always empty for eng results.
resolved_from.title: Resolved From

resolved_lemma.description: The lemma actually searched when resolved; else empty. xsc queries only — always empty for eng results.
resolved_lemma.title: Resolved Lemma

search_method.description: How the match was found: 'direct' = the query itself matched; 'lemma_index' = an ASCII/diacritic-folded spelling resolved via the reverse index; 'translations' = an English query resolved via the local gloss index.
search_method.title: Search Method

source.default: Wiktionary, the free dictionary (en.wiktionary.org), Proto-Scythian reconstruction entries. Wikimedia Foundation. Text available under CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and share-alike required when republishing. (CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) Adapted: reformatted and condensed from the original.
source.title: Source

translations.description: Populated only for eng queries (always [] for xsc): the Proto-Scythian lemmas whose glosses match the query. Entries/handles below are the expanded dictionary entries of those lemmas.
translations.title: Translations

translations_truncated.description: How many distinct matched lemmas were NOT expanded into entries because the per-search expansion cap was reached (they still appear under translations).
translations_truncated.title: Translations Truncated
